definitions.explanation: A person who does something as their main occupation, especially in sports or arts.
Someone highly skilled and experienced in a field.

examples.japanese: プロの{選手|せんしゅ}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to become a professional athlete.

examples.japanese: プロとして{仕事|しごと}をする。
{彼女|かのじょ}はプロの{料理人|りょうりにん}だ。

notes:
プロ comes from English 'professional' (abbreviated 'pro') and is very commonly used.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- プロになる (become a pro)
- プロの～ (professional ~)
- プロとして (as a professional)
- プロ{意識|いしき} (professional awareness/attitude)

SPORTS:
- プロ{野球|やきゅう} (professional baseball)
- プロサッカー (professional soccer)
- プロゴルファー (professional golfer)
- プロ{選手|せんしゅ} (professional player)

OTHER FIELDS:
- プロカメラマン (professional photographer)
- プロ{棋士|きし} (professional shogi/go player)
- プログラマー (programmer - different word)

CONTRAST:
- アマ/アマチュア (amateur)
- セミプロ (semi-professional)

RELATED WORDS:
- {専門家|せんもんか} (specialist, expert)
- {本職|ほんしょく} (professional, main job)
